name: G7 T3 W04 - Scratch delivery practice
description: Study these five words across this week. Complete Flashcards, Matching and Fill in Blank once. Then choose additional practice. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: A named operation or group of instructions that performs a task.
words.example: The deliver function moves the sprite and adds one delivery.
The loop repeats the delivery three times.

words.definition: A named place in a program that stores a value which can change.
words.example: The variable count stores the number of button presses.

words.definition: The place where an object is located.
words.example: The sprite starts at position x equals zero.

words.definition: To return something to its starting state.
words.example: Click the green flag to reset the sprite and delivery count.
